notes:
Account snapshot: Inkwell builds an IDE-first copilots product for enterprise developer teams. Primary ask: deterministic, reproducible code completions across model updates; ability to pin model version per workspace and run safe rollouts. They ship a VS Code plugin with ~2k daily active devs in pilot.

Key pain: when upstream model changes, completions shift — breaks CI tests and unit-level expectations. They want a model/version pin + canary gating flow so product releases are reproducible for customers who pin versions. Also want low-latency streaming (sub-120ms token latency) for in-editor feel.

Technical constraints: must support VPC deployment for enterprise accounts, HSM/KMS key integration, and retention policy controls for snippets. On-prem option needed for a couple regulated customers (healthtech).

Requested features discussed on calls:
- model pinning per workspace + fallback routing to a cheaper quantized variant
- deterministic eval gates: run 10k prompt suite, measure compilation-success delta, edit-distance on completions, flaky-completion rate threshold
- canary rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with automatic rollback if regressions exceed thresholds
- traceable rollout metadata (which model variant generated which completion) for debugging and audit logs
- ability to lock KV-cache seeding / prefix caching to reproduce previous completions during evals

Quotes / snippets from discovery: "We need to blame the model, not the plugin — reproducible outputs are a must for our enterprise customers." — Head of Product.

POC asks:
- reproducibility runbook + eval gate template from Redwood Optimize
- latency profile for streaming vs batch for their prompt distribution (avg len 40 tokens, 95p 250 tokens)
- sample SLO doc for canary rollouts and rollback criteria
